EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: BD/WM/LND/2/5/1/6 –II. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/7/2011/HW/04.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, The Government intends to acquire the following Lands which are for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired :

In the Province of Uva, District of Badulla, Divisional Secretariat of Welimada in the Dambawini Palatha Korale, Village of Welimada Town, Survey General F.V.P. 58 Paper No. 08 to supplement 16 and dated on 15.08.2012 Base Plot Lot Numbers From 123 to 132 The Total Extent of 0.0143 Hectare the details follow:

01. Lot No. 123 Name of the land: No; Land Details: Parts of a Temporary building; Claimant: Government; Encroached by: Bandula Gunarathna of No. 130, Nuwara Eliya Road, Welimada; Extent 0.0033 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a Servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at

the Divisional Secretariat office Welimada on the day and time relevant to each Land Lot as writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th day of December, 2017 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land and the amount of computation and the details of the compensation of such amount.
